title: Juicy Saudia Paneer Stir-fry
description: A spicy and juicy Arabian dish featuring paneer that is perfect for a midnight craving, low-fat-friendly and suitable for all meal times.

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.notes: Use a combination of cashew and onion-flavored paneer for flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger Paste
ingredients.notes: For added zing and umami taste.

ingredients.name: Garlic Paste
ingredients.notes: Use fresh garlic for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Cumin Powder
ingredients.notes: To enhance the aromatic profile of the dish.

ingredients.name: Red Chili Paste
ingredients.notes: Adjust according to spice preference for a balanced dish.

ingredients.name: Curry Leaves
ingredients.notes: For extra aroma and taste enhancement.

ingredients.name: Low-Sodium Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Use as per your preference for added flavor without making the dish too salty.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: For thinning the sauce and achieving a rich consistency.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.notes: For sautéing to ensure it's not only non-greasy but also enhancing the overall flavor profile of the dish.

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add ginger and garlic pastes, sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add paneer cubes to the pan, cook for another minute or so till they start browning slightly on their edges.
Drizzle tomato puree into the pan along with low-sodium soy sauce. Stir well to coat evenly with sauce and ensure no lumps form.
Reduce heat to medium and add cumin powder, red chili paste, coriander leaves, and fresh water. Mix well and simmer for about 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Sprinkle freshly chopped coriander over the paneer stir-fry before serving.
